comment: Owners withdrawn from routine work: both bounded search axes are spent and the owner still does not reproduce. Data for the check, not documentation -- it keeps a small number of owners out of the queue without putting a record of dead ends in front of every contributor. An entry is removed the moment its owner becomes exact. The opposite register is exact/provisional.json, which holds owners that DO match but whose source was written toward the bytes.

unmatchable.reason: The reference orders the counter increment before the volatile store and the argument load after it; the emitted pair is transposed.
